svg.text: WIREFRAME PROPOSAL — not an implemented diagnostic screen. Example values: validated synthetic foundation v1.1.
Prioritize products and sizes using volumes and return rates.
Inherited context: Trousers · 2,080 sales lines · 2,435 sold units · Oct 2025–Sep 2026
USD · Product refunds, not profit loss
Bar length: returned units · labels: returned/sold and rate
Returned units · click a bar → product evidence
Which product × size needs a closer look?
Cell: unit return rate (%) and returned/sold units
Darker = higher return rate · read counts before ranking small groups
Click a cell → sales-line evidence · View data table ↗
Product/size selections narrow the shared context. Inspect all matching sales lines, including lines without returns.
Explore reasons with the same filters →
Calculation grain: sales line → product/size aggregates. Never sum sold units after joining raw return rows.
Design only. Product bars, heatmap, evidence links and record detail will be implemented in later exercises.
